tasks.bundle: deno bundle --platform browser --format esm --output dist/client.js src/client/main.ts
tasks.dev: deno task bundle && (deno bundle --watch --platform browser --format esm --output dist/client.js src/client/main.ts & deno desktop --hmr src/app.ts)
tasks.build: deno task bundle && deno desktop -o dist/deno-desktop-webgpu src/app.ts
tasks.check: deno task bundle && deno check --desktop src/app.ts "src/**/*.test.ts"
tasks.verify: deno task format:check && deno task lint && deno task check && deno task doc:lint && deno task test
